tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
forgotIntro: Enter your username or email. If an account exists, you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgotDone: If an account matches, an email has just been sent. The link is valid for 30 minutes.
passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters, numbers and special characters.
weakPassword: This password does not meet the rules.
invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
setPasswordDone: Your password is saved. You can now sign in.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
samePassword: The new password must be different.
